title: HomeCare AI MCP executable contract

context_contract.authentication: Request-scoped existing HomeCare user JWT (Authorization Bearer)
context_contract.ownership: Spring owned conversation and product repositories
context_contract.candidate_binding: SHA256(conversation ID, context revision, product ID/revision or 0, data version)
context_contract.model_code_provenance: Spring accepts only a code typed in the latest customer message or the registered product model
context_contract.transport_security: Strict Host/Origin validation; allowed hosts 127.0.0.1/localhost plus HOMECARE_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

common_result_fields.source: data_version, verified data files and fact IDs (evidence IDs)
common_result_fields.caveats: fixed data-interpretation notices; warnings stay situational
common_result_fields.independent_action_allowed: always false; the MCP adapter rejects any other value

knowledge_result_contract.content: Human display text from the structured projection; never the embedded B30 JSON wrapper.
knowledge_result_contract.supplements: Separate projected documents with relation PROCEDURE_SUPPLEMENT; original steps/conditions are retained.
knowledge_result_contract.action_descriptions: Source candidates only. Execution approval comes exclusively from approved-plans.json.
knowledge_result_contract.retrieval: Manufacturer-only hybrid retrieval: applicability prefilter, literal codes/display labels, symptom vocabulary and cached embeddings. No result padding.
knowledge_result_contract.insufficient_evidence: NO_DATA for known models; NEEDS_INPUT with missing model_code when the model is unconfirmed.
knowledge_result_contract.safety_scope: Safety uses the same model/category exclusions as other facts. UNDETERMINED is eligible only for verified category-common scope.

repair_followup_contract.cause_candidates: At most two canonical manufacturer cause descriptions after model/category/review filters; never diagnoses or actions.
repair_followup_contract.supported_candidates: Cost inputs supported by an applicable canonical cause, reviewed error mapping, or explicit USER_PART_REQUEST. A customer part-price request does not confirm failure.
repair_followup_contract.cost_gate: candidate_set_id + category allow-list + supported candidate + confidence >= 0.5 + domestic same-part calibrationCases >= 3. Missing inputs return NO_DATA and missing_information.
repair_followup_contract.review_gate: At least three unique VERIFIED paid REFERENCE cases for the exact registered model/error, valid dates, and visit_fee_included=true. VALIDATION, other-model and duplicate cases are excluded.
repair_followup_contract.inquiry: One REPAIR_DETAIL question stored in consultation dialogue. Exact error/symptom reply retains COST intent. Explicit visit time/month are saved; conflicting values remain unknown.
repair_followup_contract.routes: COST: candidates -> estimate -> warranty, then centers/handoff when no range and no pending question. Terminal self-care: warranty -> centers -> handoff. NOT_VERIFIED is never NOT_RESOLVED.
repair_followup_contract.limits: All policy calls share the 5-call/2-per-tool/20-second MCP limits. An unfinished followup is PARTIAL; server-selected calls are POLICY_FALLBACK, never MODEL.
repair_followup_contract.booking: PREPARED_ONLY; no external transmission or reservation.

diagnostic_result_contract.approval: Explicit application-reviewed plan, exact registered model and error/symptom; never bulk approved_model_codes. Not manufacturer approval.
diagnostic_result_contract.preconditions: NEEDS_INPUT / CONFIRM_PRECONDITION with one question {id,text,source}, plan_scope and condition_answers; steps=[] until every answer is YES.
diagnostic_result_contract.binding: Data version + plan ID/revision + product ID + exact model. Product edits, symptom/error changes and risk invalidate confirmations.
diagnostic_result_contract.steps: At most one current approved step with step_code, text, caution and source; completed steps are skipped.
diagnostic_result_contract.no_self_care: Only an explicitly reviewed empty plan with disposition=NO_SELF_CARE. Missing approval is NOT_VERIFIED.

write_apis.response: ChatResponse {reply,conversationId,sources,warranty,tools}, with the updated get_diagnostic_plan. Both APIs commit state and history atomically.

notes: tools are exported from actual FastMCP discovery; annotations are MCP standard fields.
Spring Agent strips the user-only properties before exposing tools to the LLM.
check_warranty supports conversation_id (Agent) OR request (manual compatibility), never both.
The check_warranty union output has a FastMCP result wrapper; Java unwraps it.
Common Envelope.data is tool-specific JSON; financial and warranty values are validated/calculated by Spring, not JSON Schema alone.
Search results are candidates: EXCLUDED/other-model records are dropped, records without a model list are UNDETERMINED.
estimate_repair_cost returns reference ranges (weekday visit fee basis) plus cost-table visit surcharges; never a quote or a waiver decision.
Parts retention (manufacture-date basis) stays UNAVAILABLE until the B30 originals are verified.
Tool implementation does not mean complete production data: one conditional TR15WV5/UE/bundled-laundry application plan; repair reviews empty; center seed only 3 entries.

tools.name: lookup_model
tools.description:
고객이 말한 모델 코드를 판매 코드와 정확히 일치할 때만 조회한다. 제품 등록 전에도 쓸 수 있다.
원문을 보존하고 접미사를 자르거나 비슷한 코드로 바꾸지 않는다. 결과는 후보이며 부품 호환·무상 보증을 뜻하지 않는다.

model_code.description: 고객이 말한 모델 코드 원문. 자르거나 고치지 않는다.

outputSchema.description:
source names data files and fact IDs; caveats are fixed interpretation notices; warnings are situational.

independent_action_allowed is always false: a result never approves an action, free repair or part fit.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description:
제조사 구조화 자료에서 증상·정확 오류 코드와 의미 검색으로 근거 후보를 찾는다.
모델·품목·제외 조건을 먼저 검사하고, 관련 있는 안전 주의 문서를 먼저 돌려준다.
model_code가 없으면 등록 제품 모델을 쓰고, 둘 다 없으면 모델별 문서는 판정하지 않는다.
모델 목록이 없는 자료는 검증된 품목 공통 범위만 후보로 제공한다.
근거가 부족하면 NO_DATA 또는 모델 확인을 위한 NEEDS_INPUT을 반환한다.
검색 후보는 조치·무상 보증 승인이 아니다.

anyOf.description: 고객이 말한 모델 코드 원문. 자르거나 고치지 않는다.

outputSchema.description:
source names data files and fact IDs; caveats are fixed interpretation notices; warnings are situational.

independent_action_allowed is always false: a result never approves an action, free repair or part fit.

tools.description: 본인의 등록 제품과 확정 상태를 조회한다. 자동 선택·등록·수정하지 않는다.

outputSchema.description:
source names data files and fact IDs; caveats are fixed interpretation notices; warnings are situational.

independent_action_allowed is always false: a result never approves an action, free repair or part fit.

tools.name: get_diagnostic_plan
tools.description:
확정 제품의 증상·오류별 검토된 자가검진 계획을 조회한다.
선행 조건은 NEEDS_INPUT 질문으로 한 번에 하나씩 확인하며 모두 충족되기 전에는 단계를 반환하지 않는다.
승인된 현재 단계만 반환하고 해결·모든 단계 실패·조건 미충족·실행 미승인·조치 없음을 구분한다.
읽기 전용 조회이며 사용자 응답과 상태 갱신은 Spring 상담 API에서 처리한다.

outputSchema.description:
source names data files and fact IDs; caveats are fixed interpretation notices; warnings are situational.

independent_action_allowed is always false: a result never approves an action, free repair or part fit.

tools.name: check_warranty
tools.description:
제품 전체 보증과 주요 부품별 별도 보증을 계산한다. 날짜·기간·무상 항목을 추측하지 않는다.
Agent는 conversation_id를 사용한다. request는 사용자가 직접 확인한 보증 조회의 호환 입력이다.

anyOf.description:
source names data files and fact IDs; caveats are fixed interpretation notices; warnings are situational.

independent_action_allowed is always false: a result never approves an action, free repair or part fit.

tools.name: get_repair_candidates
tools.description:
제조사 근거의 원인 후보 최대 2개, 비용에 연결할 supported_candidates와 허용 부품 그룹을 조회한다.
명시적 부품 비용 문의(USER_PART_REQUEST)는 고장 진단과 구분한다. 후보 묶음은 상담·제품·자료 버전에 묶인다.
REFERENCE 후기만 사용하고 VALIDATION·다른 모델·미검증 자료는 근거에서 제외한다.

outputSchema.description:
source names data files and fact IDs; caveats are fixed interpretation notices; warnings are situational.

independent_action_allowed is always false: a result never approves an action, free repair or part fit.

tools.name: estimate_repair_cost
tools.description:
서버 허용 후보의 참고용 예상 수리비 범위(중앙·80% 범위)와 신뢰도를 계산한다. 견적이 아니다.
평일 출장비 기준이며 time_slot과 month(6~8월)는 수리비 표의 출장비 가산만 더한다. 후보들은 대안이며 합산하지 않는다.
supported_candidates와 일치하고 확신도 0.5 이상·국내 같은 부품 사례 3건 이상인 후보만 계산한다.
자료가 부족하면 NO_DATA와 부족한 정보를 반환한다. 가격·보증은 서버 자료에서 읽고 무상 여부는 판정하지 않는다.

anyOf.description: 방문 예정 월(1~12). 고객이 말했을 때만 넣는다.

outputSchema.description:
source names data files and fact IDs; caveats are fixed interpretation notices; warnings are situational.

independent_action_allowed is always false: a result never approves an action, free repair or part fit.
